title: CLIP 式对比学习：InfoNCE 损失计算
expected_output:
InfoNCE loss = 0.6875
对角线相似度(正对): [0.78, 0.78, 0.18]
code:
import math
def dot(a,b): return sum(x*y for x,y in zip(a,b))
I = [[0.9,0.1],[0.1,0.9],[0.3,0.3]]
T = [[0.85,0.15],[0.15,0.85],[0.2,0.4]]
def sim(a,b): return dot(a,b)
tau = 0.1
def infonce(I, T):
    N = len(I)
    loss = 0.0
    for i in range(N):
        num = math.exp(sim(I[i], T[i])/tau)
        den = sum(math.exp(sim(I[i], T[j])/tau) for j in range(N))
        loss += -math.log(num/den)
    return loss / N
print(f"InfoNCE loss = {infonce(I,T):.4f}")
print("对角线相似度(正对):", [round(sim(I[i],T[i]),3) for i in range(3)])
